tagline: Pencil drawings and acrylic paintings by Cindy Smith
description: Original pencil drawings, acrylic paintings, $50 prints and custom pencil portrait commissions of pets, people and wildlife by Boise, Idaho artist Cindy Smith.
pickup_note: Free local pickup in the Boise area. Cindy will email you to set a time.
print_note: Prints are the same size as the original. Need a different size? Contact Cindy.
shipping_returns:
Prints ship within 5 business days, flat in a rigid mailer. Originals ship within 7 business days, carefully packed and insured. U.S. shipping only; you'll get a tracking number by email. Free local pickup is available in the Boise area.

If anything arrives damaged, email Cindy within 7 days with a photo and she'll replace it or refund you. Prints and originals can be returned within 14 days of delivery, in their original condition, for a refund of the artwork price. Commissions are paid for only after you've approved the finished piece, so they can't be returned.
